Name: Long-Haired Cats
Author: stylbash
Description:
I can never find a long haired cat mod that I like, so I made one that looked fluffy enough to earn the name. Just three types right now, maybe more in the future. Requires Content Patcher and SMAPI.

Potential cats: Tortie, black cat, [s]tabby grey/orange[/s]?

Update: I've added grey and orange tabby cats, as well as a calico version!

Downloads.Description: Content Patcher and SMAPI required. Unzip and place mod into your /Mods folder.

Manifest.Name: some cats
Manifest.Description: replaces cat with a long haired kitty!
Manifest.Author: stylbash
